repos.description: Interactive roadmaps, guides and other educational content to help developers grow in their careers.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个社区驱动的开发者学习路线图项目，提供前端、后端、DevOps、AI工程师、数据科学等30+技术方向的交互式可视化学习路径。用户可点击节点查看详细内容，涵盖从入门到进阶的完整技能体系，帮助开发者清晰规划职业发展和技术成长方向。
repos.summary_en: This community-driven project offers interactive visual learning roadmaps for developers across 30+ technical domains including frontend, backend, DevOps, AI engineering, and data science. Users can click nodes to access detailed content, covering complete skill paths from beginner to advanced levels, helping developers clearly plan career development and technical growth.

repos.description: Course to get into Large Language Models (LLMs) with roadmaps and Colab notebooks.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个免费的LLM系统学习课程，提供从数学基础到工程实践的完整路线图。课程分为三部分：LLM基础、LLM科学家（模型构建与优化）和LLM工程师（应用开发与部署）。包含大量实用的Google Colab notebooks，涵盖模型微调、合并、量化、评估等实战技术，并配套自动化工具，适合想深入LLM领域的开发者。
repos.summary_en: This is a free, comprehensive LLM course offering structured learning paths from mathematical foundations to production deployment. The curriculum is divided into three parts: LLM Fundamentals, The LLM Scientist (focusing on building optimal models with cutting-edge techniques), and The LLM Engineer (covering application development and deployment). It provides extensive Google Colab notebooks for hands-on practice, including tools for fine-tuning, model merging, quantization, and automated evaluation. Based on the LLM Engineer's Handbook, it's designed for developers seeking practical LLM expertise.

repos.description: AI Code Guide is a roadmap to start coding with AI
repos.summary_zh: AI编程指南：系统梳理AI辅助代码生成工具链与实践，整合vibe coding、MCP/A2A协议等前沿知识。面向开发者和零基础者，提供一站式学习路径与批判性视角。
repos.summary_en: AI Coding Guide: Roadmap covering vibe coding, MCP protocols, AI tools for developers and beginners.
